# Dashboard warning lights

Every light the Astra has thrown at me, what it meant, and what fixed it. Plus the general colour rule so I stop panicking.

## The rule

- **Red** = stop when safe. Oil pressure, coolant temp, brake system, charging, airbag
- **Amber** = get it looked at soon. Engine management, ABS, TPMS, traction, glow plug (diesel only)
- **Green/blue** = just information. Lights on, main beam, cruise

## Code reader

Foxwell NT301 OBD2 reader, £39 off Amazon in 2022. Plugs in under the steering column, right side of the fuse cover. Reads and clears engine codes only, not ABS or airbag. For those, Stavros at Fishponds Autos has a proper Autel and does a scan for a tenner.

## Engine management light (EML)

### Nov 2024, P0171

- Came on at 116,800 miles on the M32 inbound. Car felt fine, maybe a slightly lumpy idle
- Foxwell: **P0171 System Too Lean (Bank 1)**. Long term fuel trim +18% at idle, dropping to +4% at 2,500 rpm. That pattern means unmetered air, i.e. a vacuum leak, not a fuel problem
- Sprayed carb cleaner around the intake with it idling: revs jumped near the PCV hose at the back of the rocker cover
- Split PCV breather hose, Vauxhall part 55564395, £17.40 from the Vauxhall parts counter at Bristol Street Motors
- Fitted in 20 minutes, cleared the code, fuel trims back to +2%. Light stayed off

### Feb 2025, P0420

- Catalyst efficiency below threshold. Came on once, went off on its own after 3 drive cycles
- Probably a lazy downstream O2 sensor or an old cat at 119k. Left it and watched it. Didn't come back before the sale

## Oil pressure light

Aug 2023, flickered on at a hot idle in traffic on Temple Way. Pulled over straight away, dipstick showed well under MIN. About 1.1L low. Hadn't checked it for two months, my fault. Topped up, light went out, been checking every other fill-up since. This is why the change interval is shorter in [[Oil change intervals]].

## Airbag light

- On permanently from Jan 2025
- Stavros's scan: driver seat belt pretensioner circuit resistance too high
- Fault was the yellow connector under the driver's seat, pulled half out by a dropped water bottle rolling under there
- Battery disconnected 10 min, reseated and clipped, he cleared it. £15 for the scan
- Airbag light on = MOT fail, so glad that was before March

## Brake warning light

Red (!) in a circle. On the Astra it's either the handbrake or low fluid. Came on briefly on left hand bends in Sept 2024, fluid was just above MIN because the pads were so worn (see [[Brake pad wear]]). Didn't top it up because pads coming in would push it back, which is what happened after the brake job.

## Battery light

Came on once, the morning the car wouldn't start in January 2024. That was the battery, not the alternator. Checked charging voltage after: 14.2V at 2,000 rpm, fine. See [[Car battery jump start]].

## TPMS

Amber tyre with an exclamation mark. Usually means I forgot to reset after inflating. Process in [[Tyre pressure]].

## The MG

Completely different set of icons and a screen that shouts at you about everything. The orange turtle means reduced power, low battery. Haven't seen it yet and I'd like to keep it that way.
